About the Role

Join an early-stage sales team at a data and infrastructure company, working closely with sales leadership to turn technical interest into commercial opportunities. This hands-on role offers broad exposure to building a sales organization and developing customer relationships.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and engage prospective customers using product adoption, community participation, cloud sign-ups, and other intent signals.

  • Research organizations, engineering teams, technology stacks, and potential use cases.

  • Conduct personalized outreach across email, professional networking platforms, community channels, and other relevant channels.

  • Participate in discovery calls, technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and commercial negotiations.

  • Gradually manage smaller accounts through the sales cycle, from initial outreach to contract execution.

  • Work with solutions architects and engineers to understand customer requirements and support evaluations.

  • Test prospecting strategies, messaging, tools, and channels to improve sales efficiency.

  • Help build repeatable sales processes and share customer feedback with product and engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Zero to two years of professional experience, or a final-year student or recent graduate.

  • Prior internship or work experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, or a customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, curiosity, and the ability to ask thoughtful questions.

  • Initiative, organization, resourcefulness, and a coachable, competitive mindset.

  • Interest in learning quickly and experimenting in an environment where processes are still developing.

  • Familiarity with databases, cloud computing, data infrastructure, or developer tools is helpful but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $60,000 to $80,000 annually, plus commission. Target OTE (on-target earnings, base plus variable) is approximately $120,000 to $160,000, with a target 50/50 base-to-variable split.

Location

On-site. Location not specified.

Compensation Range: $60K - $80K
